name: Chandragupta II
role: Gupta emperor from c. 375 to c. 415
contribution: The emperor of the Gupta Empire from c. 375 until his death in c. 415.
legacy: Under the reign of this person, the Gupta Empire reached its zenith, directly controlling a vast territory which stretched from the Oxus River in the west to the Bengal region in the east, and from the foothills of the Himalayas in the north to the Narmada River in the south.

checks.lead: Chandragupta II (died c. 415), also known by his title Vikramaditya, as well as Chandragupta Vikramaditya, was the emperor of the Gupta Empire from c. 375 until his death in c. 415. Modern scholars generally identify him with King Chandra of the Delhi iron pillar inscription.
